chunks: What was narrated by Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Ṣafwān, from ʿAbd al-Wahhāb, from Muḥammad ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Hishām ibn Sālim, from Ismāʿīl al-Juʿfī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about touching the bone of the dead person. He said: “If a year has passed, then there is no harm in it.”
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on touching the bone of a dead person after a year has passed?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning touching the bone of a dead person. It indicates that once a year has passed, there is no problem in doing so, and it is relevant to discussions of ritual purity and impurity in fiqh.
